headline: Infineon lists AMS internships covering behavioral models, corner validation and regression automation
fact: On October 5, Infineon listed related AMS verification internships in Andover and Shanghai. The Andover role assigns Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog behavioral models, testbenches, regressions and device/system checks under nominal and corner conditions. The Shanghai role covers AMS IP and SoC environments, SPICE/Verilog-AMS/Spectre simulations, RTL/model integration debug, Python-based regression reporting, and validation of model assumptions and corner behavior. These related student hiring signals are grouped in one Event.
